# SemanticGroup

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A layout container that wraps its children in an explicit PDF/UA semantic structure role. Use this when a block of content has a specific role (e.g. Sect, Art, BlockQuote) that isn't expressed by any of the individual child elements.

When tagging is enabled (`PdfUa1`) the pipeline wraps the whole group in a single structure element with the configured `SemanticRole`. Children that are themselves `IRoleProvider` get their own nested structure elements.

Namespace `BonniePDF`. Extends `VerticalStack`. Implements `IRoleProvider`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new SemanticGroup(SemanticRole role)
```

## Properties

- [`SemanticRole`](#semanticrole): The role the group was created with.
